CheckTitle: Global session lifetime is finite and not excessively long
Description: Checks broad global session rules for a finite maximum session lifetime.
Risk: Overly long or unbounded sessions increase the value and persistence of stolen browser sessions.

Code.Other:
1. In the Okta Admin Console, go to Security > Global Session Policy or Security > Okta Sign-on Policy.
2. Open the broad/default policy and edit the applicable rule.
3. Set Session expires after to a finite duration, preferably two hours or less for broad policies.
4. Save the rule and test user sign-in behavior.

Recommendation.Text: Set a finite global session lifetime that is no longer than the approved threshold.

Notes: Requires the Okta read scopes documented for the referenced management APIs.
